answer: Grade answers blind, after a neutral model rewrites each one in its own words. A sybil farm hoping to boost its clones needs them to recognize each other on a panel, so it hides a signal in the text: a pet phrase, an odd mention of a willow by the river, a habit of the operator's quill. Paraphrasing launders that signal away, and authors stay hidden until scores are sealed. With no whisper getting through, clones grade their siblings like strangers, so packing panels buys nothing.
